archetypes.name: dyn-gate-contract
archetypes.rationale: Approval gate prose compression can silently drop orchestration contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the approval-gates.md compression for lost Gate A, Gate B, or Gate C control-flow obligations. Check retained grep-pinned literals, fail-closed branches, and renderer-owned prompt boundaries against the plan. Focus on semantic drift introduced by shortening prose, not style. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
